column3: Kuroneko Route · The Frying Pan and the Fish
And so, on the way home after school.
Kyou-chan, did you give that souvenir to Kuroneko-san?
Geez, that won't do. Holidays start tomorrow, you know?
I wonder if she usually passes through here...
Ah... Kyou-chan, there she is, Kuroneko-san!
Look, over there. It's a little far but that's Kuroneko-san, right?
...Were you going out of your way to run after me?
So then, what is it you need of me?
